issue.title: Rustc wrapper aborts builds on sccache server transport failures instead of falling back
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1sl.1.1.3 note #1 and independently reproduced by the sase-1sl.1.1 lander. The unchanged chezmoi home/bin/executable_sase-rustc-wrapper invokes exec sccache once Poseidon storage checks pass. A reachable sccache that fails with a server transport error therefore exits the build without running the real compiler; the mount-pressure and missing-binary fallbacks do not help. A healthy-mount injected test with an sccache stub emitting connection reset by peer and exiting 2 returns 2 and never invokes a successful compiler stub.

Implement bounded uncached fallback for sccache server transport failures while preserving genuine compiler failures, compiler argv, the incremental routing split, and the ban on fallback caches on the root filesystem. Add bash tests for the transport-failure branch, normal cached success, compiler failure without accidental success masking, and direct metadata compilation. Verify through the chezmoi project workflow. This is medium because the failing exec branch and focused wrapper/test files are identified; no new subsystem is required.

Triage: all-status bug and all-task searches plus last-week sweeps found no duplicate. sase-1p0 concerns NVMe write volume, not transport reliability. Active sase-165 and its closed phase .7 changed incremental routing, but git history shows the unconditional exec branch predates it in a01facce and remains unchanged by 034c594b; no credible causal active-epic owner was found. Keep related links to those two overlapping areas. This is unrelated to capacity scanner implementation.

task_type_fields.impact: Transient cache-server I/O failures abort otherwise compilable Rust builds and verification gates.
task_type_fields.repro: Inject healthy Poseidon test values and a PATH sccache stub that emits connection reset by peer and exits 2. Invoke the wrapper with a compiler stub that records execution and exits 0. Observed wrapper exit 2 and compiler_called=False.

issue.creation_reason: Capacity benchmark phase sase-1sl.1.1.3 reported repeated sccache connection resets; the lander independently reproduced the missing fallback in the unchanged managed wrapper.

payload.description: Both affect sccache on Athena; write-volume reduction and transport fallback are distinct work
